profile.headline: AWS Cloud Staff Engineer at Booz Allen Hamilton
profile.summary: As a young and eager Software Engineer, I hope to continue developing client-facing programs using my growing knowledge of cloud services and related delivery techniques. After graduating from the University of Virginia with two majors in Computer Science and Economics as well as two minors in Statistics and Mathematics, I have succeeded in placing myself in situations where I can develop my foundation for software development. I believe this foundation along with my drive to learn new technologies will make me a useful team member on any team I am on.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architect and maintain large-scale cloud migration strategies for the Department of Veterans Affairs within a multi-team
Agile environment. Lead DevOps initiatives by taking ownership of the cloud infrastructure and Control-M Batch processor
sub-groups, driving technical discussions and setting sub-group objectives. Orchestrate cloud infrastructure across an
18-environment landscape using Terraform and Ansible via GitHub to ensure high availability and scalability. Author
comprehensive technical documentation and infrastructure diagrams to streamline onboarding and maintain architectural
integrity. Suggest, refine, enact, and deploy solutions in accordance with the Software Development Lifecycle.

positions.title: Associate Engineer - Software Engineer
positions.description: Collaborate within the Maximus Internal Research & Development and Cloud Solutions teams to support other DevOps divisions. Practice Agile methodologies while building client web applications in multiple frameworks (HTML, Vue, React) to coherently display information from AWS Cloud solutions. Support other team members in creating automated code deployments for other divisions via serverless solutions (Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins).

positions.title: Student Intern (Paid)
positions.description: Drafting monthly reports into easily consumed deliverables for executives. Support team functions via acquiring accounting data as necessary. Conceive and implement better practices for new member/intern onboarding.

positions.title: Student Intern (Paid)
positions.description: Provide aid for Albemarle County Office of Equity and Inclusion such as researching historical claims and conducting surveys of local residents.
